title: Audio classification arm: frozen wav2vec2-base + ridge probe on Speech Commands v2
registered_in: analysis/RESEARCH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v25.md (M266 registered 21 Aug; M266b dispatched 21 Aug, local-first)
question: Does a trained probe on frozen Wav2Vec2 features classify Speech Commands v2 held-out utterances, and where does the reading sit against the published fine-tuned anchor?

encoder.pooling: mean of frame features over time

dataset.source: official speech_commands_v0.02 archive (download.tensorflow.org/data/speech_commands_v0.02.tar.gz, 2.43 GB), local extraction on F:; splits from testing_list.txt / validation_list.txt (the official convention)
dataset.note: the HF 'speech_commands' entry is a legacy script dataset unsupported by datasets 5.x

probe.model: closed-form ridge least squares on one-hot targets (Gram solve)
probe.input_standardisation: per-column z-score fitted on the train split only
probe.note: the closed-form ridge IS the exact fit on frozen features — the registered 'head question' for this cell

anchors_reference_only.note: published numbers cited as context only — never a gate, never exceeded, never claimed
anchors_reference_only.finetuned_ceiling: Baevski et al. 2020 (arXiv:2006.11477), Wav2Vec 2.0: Speech Commands v2 ~98.1 fine-tuned — NOT this cell's frozen-probe regime
